verdict.rationale: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator for coding agents. It installs via npm and runs on the user's own machine against local Git checkouts and worktrees, so local execution of the agent orchestration is documented. Nothing addresses containerized deployment, running on your own VMs, or framing it as self-hostable agent infrastructure. Missing for 10: container/Docker deployment docs, VM/server deployment guidance, explicit self-hosting documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can self-host agent infrastructure locally, in containers, or on my own VMs

citations.quote: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator for coding agents, repeatable workflows, and receipt-backed repository changes.
`task start` freezes the protected target SHA, creates a dedicated branch/worktree, and completes configured dependency hydration before reporting `WORKING`.
Serve bounded local views without exposing a mutation API.
